description: Main window only: app_info; playlist import (fetch a user-supplied http(s) M3U address, or parse text from a file the user picked); HLS playback sessions (open_stream returns only an opaque kstream address; close_stream ends it); saved sources (load_sources, save_sources: one Rust-owned file in the app's data folder, validated on every save). No filesystem, shell, HTTP, dialog or other plugin access.
